paths.name: react
paths.message: The engine must stay pure. It is one half of a cross-language pair with Puzzle.Domain and is held in step by conformance fixtures; importing React makes its behaviour depend on a render tree. Put UI state in src/game/ instead.

paths.name: react-dom
paths.message: The engine must stay pure - no DOM. Put rendering in src/skins/ and state binding in src/game/.

paths.name: motion
paths.message: Animation belongs in src/game/ and src/skins/, not in the rules engine.

paths.name: motion/react
paths.message: Animation belongs in src/game/ and src/skins/, not in the rules engine.

patterns.message: The engine sits below game and skins and must not depend upward on them.
